name: Traveler's Keepsake
description: A worn amulet that has seen too many close calls to count. Against all expectations, it keeps working.

effects.name: Last-Second Dodge
effects.description: When you take a hit that deals 25% or more of your Max HP in damage, gain +8 DR against the next incoming attack.

effects.name: Matched Set
effects.description: When both Traveler's set pieces are equipped, the DR bonus from Last-Second Dodge is doubled to +16.

name: Traveler's Band
description: A battered copper ring you've been meaning to replace for years. You keep putting it off.

effects.name: Floor It
effects.description: When you roll a 2 or 3 on a 2d10 Defense check, take half damage instead of the full amount.

effects.name: Matched Set
effects.description: When both Traveler's set pieces are equipped, Floor It negates all damage instead of halving it.

name: Ancient Mote
description: A coin of unknown origin that clings to your palm like it was made for it. You've never been able to place where it came from.

effects.name: Chosen Power
effects.description: Choose one power you own. That power always Benefits. You cannot willingly drop the Mote.

effects.name: Corruption
effects.description: You gain an extra 1d4 Ruin per session. The GM may call for Resonance rolls (2d10+MIND vs TN 15) when the Mote's influence becomes relevant.

name: Frozen Teardrop
description: A crystalline gem that emits a faint mournful light. Said to belong to someone who gave everything for those they loved.

effects.name: Interpose
effects.description: Once per Full Rest, protect an adjacent Ally from a fatal blow. If the incoming damage exceeds half the target's Max HP, this effect fails.

effects.name: Final Gift
effects.description: Once per campaign, touch a fallen ally who died within the last 24 hours to revive them. This destroys the artifact permanently.

name: Ironbreaker
description: A massive iron maul that smells faintly of scorched stone. The fire comes when it counts.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Fury Strike
effects.description: On an attack roll of 18–20, deal additional Fire damage equal to your MIGHT.

upgrades.name: Conflagration
upgrades.description: Fury Strike also forces a MIGHT vs. MIGHT contest. If you win, the target gains Hindrance for 1 round. If you lose, you are Staggered for 1 round.

name: Whisperbow
description: A bow carved from wood that doesn't grow here. Each arrow loosed hums softly as it flies.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Burning Arrow
effects.description: Expend 1 Class Resource. Make a Basic Ranged attack at Very Far range that deals Fire damage instead of Physical.

upgrades.name: Second Volley
upgrades.description: Passive. On an attack roll of 16–20, make a second Basic Ranged attack against the same target for free.

name: Thundergavel
description: A war hammer that crackles with bridled lightning. It strikes once, but it strikes completely.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Verdict
effects.description: Once per Full Rest, make a Basic Melee attack against an adjacent target. On a hit, deal Electric damage and Stun the target for 1 round. On a miss, deal half Electric damage and Stagger the target for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Shockwave
upgrades.description: Passive. On any Melee attack roll of 16–20, deal an additional 1d8 Electric damage.

name: Scholar's Beacon
description: A staff topped with an ever-burning flame. It illuminates paths that weren't there a moment ago.

effects.name: Insight
effects.description: Gain one additional Tier 1 power or upgrade from your class. This bonus is lost if you stop wielding the Beacon. You cannot upgrade the bonus, and your choice is locked once bonded.

upgrades.name: Deep Knowledge
upgrades.description: Passive. While wielding the Scholar's Beacon, your Primary Class Resource maximum increases by 1.

name: Dualbrow
description: A two-faced maul — one side fierce, one side serene. Neither expression offers any comfort.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Stance
effects.description: Focus on the fierce face: gain AR up to half your Level but lose the same as DR. Focus on the serene face: gain DR up to half your Level but lose the same as AR. Look away and it functions as a mundane weapon. Your chosen stance locks until a Full Rest.

upgrades.name: Crushing Weight
upgrades.description: Passive. When you roll the maximum value on any damage die, the target is Rooted for 1 round. Elites are immune.

name: Steadfast
description: A long rifle that fires with quiet precision. Every round placed deliberately, every shot counted.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: True Aim
effects.description: Reroll any damage dice that show a 1 or 2. Use the new result.

upgrades.name: Patience
upgrades.description: Passive. For each consecutive round you remain stationary, gain +2 damage, stacking up to your current Level. Moving resets the bonus.

name: Vialshot
description: A pistol with a glass vial socket on the barrel. Whatever you load into it comes out changed.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Charged Shot
effects.description: The vial socket charges with arcane energy. Expend the charge to fire an arcane-infused shot.

upgrades.name: Glass Grenade
upgrades.description: Passive. The vial can be thrown as a grenade, dealing 4d4 Arcane damage to the target and all adjacent creatures. Vialshot loses Charged Shot until a new vial is placed.

name: Nightedge
description: A longsword with a blade dark as a starless sky. It finds gaps in armor as if guided by instinct.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Unerring
effects.description: On an attack roll of 17–20, completely ignore the target's AV for that attack.

effects.name: Keen Edge
effects.description: +1 Presence while equipped.

upgrades.name: Relentless Edge
upgrades.description: Passive. Unerring now triggers on an attack roll of 14–20 instead of 17–20.

name: Deflection Bracers
description: Heavy steel bracers etched with deflection sigils. They have stopped more arrows than most shields.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 DR.

effects.name: Counter
effects.description: On a Defense roll of 18–20, deflect any reasonably-sized ranged physical projectile back at the attacker.

upgrades.name: Arcane Mirror
upgrades.description: Counter now also deflects magical ranged projectiles.

name: Duelist's Bulwark
description: A tower shield bearing the crest of a forgotten dueling order. It rewards those who commit to the fight.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 AV.

effects.name: Duel
effects.description: When you and your target are the only two ADJACENT units in the engagement, gain your HL as a bonus to both AR and damage.

name: Darkweave Coat
description: Armor that seems to absorb the light around it. Moving in it barely makes a sound.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 AV.

effects.name: Slippery
effects.description: +2 DR against Provoked Attacks.

effects.name: Nightstalker
effects.description: While both Darkweave Coat and Shadowstep Boots are equipped, deal an additional 1d6 Physical damage on a successful Melee attack against a target ADJACENT to one of your Allies.

name: Shadowstep Boots
description: Soft-soled boots that leave no sound and almost no trace. Built for those who prefer not to be found.

effects.name: Silent Step
effects.description: Add your HL to any roll involving sneaking or staying undetected.

effects.name: Nightstalker
effects.description: While both Darkweave Coat and Shadowstep Boots are equipped, deal an additional 1d6 Physical damage on a successful Melee attack against a target ADJACENT to one of your Allies.

name: Dawncleaver
description: A greatsword blazing with golden light. It remembers every blessed strike it has ever made.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +2 damage.

effects.name: Radiant Echo
effects.description: On an attack roll of 19–20, replicate all Divine damage dealt that round to the same target.

upgrades.name: Brilliance
upgrades.description: Radiant Echo now triggers on an attack roll of 17–20 instead of 19–20.

upgrades.name: Sacred Edge
upgrades.description: Passive. While wielding Dawncleaver, the Judge power 'Divine Proclamation' doubles its bonus from +HL to +Level.

name: Emberdagger
description: A dagger forged in dragonfire. It keeps you warm even when nothing else does.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Flame-Touched
effects.description: When you deal Fire damage through a power, add additional Fire damage equal to your HL.

effects.name: Heat Ward
effects.description: +7 Frost Resistance.

upgrades.name: Dragonbreath
upgrades.description: Passive. Gain the Mystic power Firebreath. Activate it by expending Primary Resource. If you already possess Firebreath, its Mana cost is reduced to 1.

name: Bloodfang Knuckle
description: A bladed fist weapon that grows sharper with each life it takes. It is not satisfied.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Life Drain
effects.description: When you land a killing blow, heal 1 HP.

effects.name: Growing Edge
effects.description: After 10 kills with the Bloodfang Knuckle, the healing from Life Drain permanently increases by 1. This can stack up to a maximum bonus of +4.

name: Quickstep Anklets
description: Lightweight anklets that hum with restless energy. You feel it even when standing still.

effects.name: Dancer
effects.description: +2 DR against Provoked Attacks.

effects.name: Restless
effects.description: Narrative effect: your legs bounce and fidget whenever you are stationary for more than 5 minutes. Stops only when lying down.

upgrades.name: First Blood
upgrades.description: Once per Full Rest, grant yourself First Strike at the start of an encounter. Doing so deals True damage equal to your Level.

name: Dawnblade
description: One of a matched pair. Lighter than it looks, and faster than you expect.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Nature's Grace
effects.description: +3 Speed when in natural or forested settings.

effects.name: Twin Blades
effects.description: While both Dawnblade and Duskblade are equipped (outdoors only): Overdrive/Movement — instantly move FAR without triggering Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: As One
upgrades.description: Set Bonus. Dawnblade and Duskblade join into a double-bladed glaive, upgrading the damage die to 1d10.

name: Duskblade
description: One of a matched pair. It settles into the hand like it was always meant to be there.

effects.name: Enhanced
effects.description: +1 damage.

effects.name: Cover of Dark
effects.description: +2 to stealth-related checks when in natural or forested settings.

effects.name: Twin Blades
effects.description: While both Dawnblade and Duskblade are equipped (outdoors only): Overdrive/Movement — instantly move FAR without triggering Provoked Attacks.

upgrades.name: As One
upgrades.description: Set Bonus. Dawnblade and Duskblade join into a double-bladed glaive, upgrading the damage die to 1d10.

name: Accord of Flesh
description: A book that writes its contracts in your own hand. You don't remember signing, but the terms are always clear.

effects.name: Binding Deal
effects.description: Choose 1 Main Attribute and increase it by 1, losing 5 Max HP as the price. Tear the page to void the contract. Only 1 contract may be active at a time. The tome has 10 uses total.

upgrades.name: Second Terms
upgrades.description: Unlock a secondary contract slot. The second contract must target AR, DR, MR, Speed, or AV (+1 for 5 Max HP). Adds 5 additional uses to the tome.
